title: 第七章 鄙视与嘲讽第八章 躁动的武脉
content_zh:
什么替节约郡国资源，以赵天乐这狗屁身份，轮得到他去替郡国节约资源？还不都是落入了他的私囊。
尤其这炼体丹，对刚觉醒武脉的人而言非常重要，能够大大提升凝练内劲的速度，对武士境前几重境界有极大效用。
“觉醒武脉的第一年是武者最重要的一年。
我还记得我父亲在世的时候，赵仑觉醒武脉，一共得到了十二枚炼体丹，不但大大提升了凝练内劲的速度，还让他在最短时间内进入第二重牛劲，赵天乐，为什么我只能得到一颗？”
叶枫直呼其名！
赵天乐冷声道：“赵仑是赵仑，你是你，赵仑少爷七岁觉醒五条土属性武脉，玄阶中品天赋，进阶先天大道有望，你一个一条武脉的废物岂能和少爷相比？”
赵勇献媚道：“少爷可是我赵家庄嫡子，继承了庄主的强大修武天赋，整个巴立城都排上号的青年才俊，将来我们赵家庄能不能更加兴盛，更加强大，全都系在少爷一人身上。”
旁边的赵火也道：“说一句不爱听的话，少爷手指头上一片指甲，都要比你这废物的性命重要十倍，你们根本没有可比性……”
叶枫声色俱厉，一声怒喝，“赵勇，当年你觉醒武脉，也是得到了四颗炼体丹。
赵火，如果我没有记错的话，我父亲更是赏赐给你六颗……”
这句话让赵勇和赵火神情一滞。
叶天对庄客十分爱护，为人有公正，不管姓叶还是姓赵都一视同仁，基本上在场这些人都受过他的恩惠。
赵天乐恼羞成怒起来，十分不悦的道：“天赋越高，得到的资源越多。
你一条武脉的废物，得到一颗炼体丹就不错了，还不快滚回去。”
“废物，垃圾，快滚。”
“给你一颗炼体丹是执事大人发善心，再要是唧唧歪歪，一颗都没有。”
“废物就是欠扁，还一口一个他父亲，他以为这庄子还姓叶？”
“一条武脉的废物，跟不能觉醒武脉有什么区别，小废物以前是废物，现在更是废物中的废物……”
一时间风言风语四起，如赵火、赵勇等等，口中骂的越发刻薄无耻……
“我哥哥不是废物！”

“把我们应得的银子、丹药还给我们。”
花菱感到无比愤怒。
她辛辛苦苦起大早摘野菜，甚至一碗白粥都舍不得喝，可是现在，这群如狼似虎的赵姓人却要贪墨属于他们的东西，辱骂自己的哥哥废物垃圾，纵然是一个弱女子，这个时候，花菱实在无法继续忍受下去。
“小丫头，他不是废物谁是废物？你跟着他迟早饿死，不如来陪我们执事大人，以后吃香的喝辣的。”
赵火脸上一脸的淫邪。
其他人都哄笑起来，花菱小脸通红，握紧小拳头，而在她身后不远处，围观的赵姓族人没有一个愿意帮他们出头的。
赵姓族人巴不得叶枫去死，怎么会在此刻冒着得罪执事赵天乐的风险，为他们说话？
“我哥哥不是废物！”
content_en:
Why save the resources of the county and the country? With Zhao Tianle's shit status, it is his turn to save the resources of the county and the country? Not all of it fell into his own pocket.
In particular, this body refining pill is very important for those who have just awakened the martial arts. It can greatly increase the speed of condensing internal energy, and is very useful for the first few levels of the warrior realm.
“The first year of awakening the martial arts is the most important year for a warrior.
I still remember that when my father was alive, Zhao Lun awakened his martial arts and got a total of twelve body refining pills, which not only greatly increased the speed of condensing internal energy, but also allowed him to enter the second level of Niu Jin in the shortest time. Zhao Tianle, why can I only get one? "
Ye Feng called him by his first name!
Zhao Tianle said coldly: "Zhao Lun is Zhao Lun, and you are you. Young Master Zhao Lun awakened five earth-attribute martial arts veins at the age of seven. He has a mid-level talent at the Xuan level and is expected to advance to the Xiantian Dao. How can you, a waste of martial arts veins, compare with the young master?"
Zhao Yong said flatteringly: "The young master is the legitimate son of my Zhaojiazhuang. He has inherited the strong martial arts talent of the owner and is a young talent ranked among the best in the entire city of Bali. Whether our Zhaojiazhuang can become more prosperous and stronger in the future depends on the young master alone."
Zhao Huo, who was next to him, also said: "I don't want to hear anything, but a nail on the young master's finger is ten times more important than the life of a loser like you. There is no comparison between you..."
Ye Feng's voice was fierce and he shouted angrily, "Zhao Yong, when you awakened your martial arts, you also got four body refining pills.
Zhao Huo, if I remember correctly, my father even rewarded you with six..."
This sentence made Zhao Yong and Zhao Huo pause.
Ye Tian loved his dealers very much and was fair. Regardless of whether they were surnamed Ye or Zhao, they were treated equally. Basically, all the people present had received his favor.
Zhao Tianle became angry from embarrassment and said displeasedly: "The higher the talent, the more resources you will get.
You are a useless piece of martial art. It would be great if you got a body refining pill. Why don't you go back quickly? "
"Trash, trash, get out of here."
"I gave you a Body Refining Pill out of kindness, the deacon. If you are too nagging, I won't get even one."
"The good-for-nothing owes Bian a debt of gratitude for his father. Does he think Zhuangzi's surname is Ye?"
"What is the difference between a waste with a martial vein and a person who cannot awaken the martial vein? The little waste was waste before, but now it is a waste among wastes..."
For a time, rumors spread everywhere, such as Zhao Huo, Zhao Yong, etc., and the curses became more and more mean and shameless...
"My brother is not a waste!"
"Give us back the silver and elixirs we deserve."
Hanabishi felt extremely angry.
She worked hard to get up early to pick wild vegetables, and even refused to drink a bowl of white porridge. But now, this group of wolf-like Zhao people want to covet what belongs to them and insult her brother as a trash. Even though he is a weak woman, at this time, Hua Ling really can't bear it anymore.
"Little girl, who is a waste if he is not a waste? If you follow him, you will starve to death sooner or later. Why don't you come and accompany us, the deacon, so that you can be popular and drink spicy food from now on."
Zhao Huo had a look of lust on his face.
The others burst into laughter. Hua Ling's face turned red and she clenched her fists. Not far behind her, none of the Zhao clan members who were watching were willing to help them.
The people of the Zhao tribe wanted Ye Feng to die, so why would they risk offending the deacon Zhao Tianle to speak for them now?
"My brother is not a waste!"
